definitions.warm: same executable path repeatedly launched; no reboot or cache purge
definitions.fresh_copy: first launch of a new local copy/inode; NOT proven cold filesystem, dyld or security cache
definitions.memory: separate /usr/bin/time -l processes; RSS and peak footprint are distinct macOS byte metrics
definitions.acceptance: adopted schema2 measurement verdict; final source delivery still requires owner gates
